title: 觅长生
notes: Started from Highball's library (`steam.exe -silent -applaunch 1189490`). Played for about 7 minutes: the main menu, the world map, and the market scene (坊市) with a character interaction panel open. Readings are at the desktop's 1920x1080 — the panel is 3840x2160 with "UI looks like 1920x1080 @ 160 Hz". This session's log carries no `Setting display mode:` line, so the game did not switch the display itself. Frame rate on the Metal HUD: the main menu and the world map sit at 160 fps, that mode's refresh rate. The market scene with the panel open reads 67.84 fps. Nothing else to report — no crash, no error the app could read. Unity title, 64-bit, D3D11 (feature level 11_1). No mods: the game ships a Workshop loader (`doorstop_config.ini`), but `steamapps/workshop/content/1189490` does not exist and `MCSSave/ModsDetails.txt` lists nothing. For the page: the Steam store carries no English title for this one — the store URL falls back to `/app/1189490/_/` — so the slug needs a romanisation.
